41.
No action shall lie against the Monetary Board of the
Central Bank, or its members, any officer, employee, director
of the the Central Bank, or any person acting under the direction
of the Central Bank, for anything lawfully done or omitted to
be done in good faith in the exercise  or performance  of any
powers,  duties or functions under this Act, which are intended
or authorized to be exercised or performed.

42.
Subject to the provisions of the Constitution, in the
event of an application for judicial review being made of any
designation  under  this  Act  or  of  any  directive  issued
thereunder, no stay of the designation or directive shall be
granted, pending the final disposition of the application.
